title: Layer 3 Switch SVIs and Routed Ports
summary: Configure multilayer switch inter-VLAN routing with Switched Virtual Interfaces (SVIs), convert physical interfaces to Layer 3 routed ports using no switchport, and establish static default routing to an upstream router.
learning_objectives: Contrast Layer 2 switches with multilayer Layer 3 switches and explain hardware-based CEF routing.
Create and activate Switched Virtual Interfaces (SVIs) as default gateways for multiple VLAN domains.
Enable global IPv4 routing on a multilayer switch using the ip routing command.
Convert a supported physical switchport into a Layer 3 routed port using no switchport and assign an IPv4 subnet.
Configure a default static route to connect a multilayer switch to an upstream router and configure return routes.
Compare multilayer switching performance, scalability, and latency against legacy Router-on-a-Stick architectures.
Diagnose and troubleshoot SVI operational states, routing table convergence, and asymmetric return routing issues.
